name: Typhoid Fever
overview: Typhoid Fever is a health condition that requires individualized medical assessment. Symptoms, causes, and treatment vary by person — consult a qualified doctor in India for diagnosis and a care plan tailored to your history and local guidelines.
symptoms: In routine practice, typhoid fever, also known as typhoid, is an orally contracted disease caused by Salmonella enterica serotype Typhi bacteria, also called Salmonella Typhi.
From a clinical perspective, often there is a gradual onset of a high fever over several days.
From a clinical perspective, some people develop a skin rash with rose colored spots.
